Two disciples (Peter and John) walking down a dusty street in ancient Jerusalem, spotting a man ahead of them carrying a large clay water jar on his shoulder. They are gesturing towards him.

Jesus, kneeling on the floor with a towel tied around His waist, washing the feet of a seated, surprised-looking Peter from a small basin of water. The other disciples watch in amazement. Warm evening lighting.
A wooden table with a piece of broken flatbread and a simple cup of red wine. Jesus' hands are shown breaking the bread, offering it to the disciples gathered around.
